Name: Rebalanced Resource Shops
Author: Damentia
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]I made this mod primarily to make some usually unpurchasable resources available for purchase at their respective shops, including the usual Year 2+ price increases.

[b]Robin’s Carpenter Shop
[/b]
New resources become available as your [b]Foraging skill[/b] improves:[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Hardwood[/b] – Unlocks at Foraging Level 6[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Clay[/b] – Unlocks immediately (no skill requirement)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Fibre[/b] – Unlocks immediately (no skill requirement)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Moss[/b] – Unlocks at Foraging Level 9[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial][b]Clint’s Blacksmith[/b]

Additional ores unlock with your [b]Mining skill[/b]:[/font][/size][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Iridium Ore[/b] – Unlocks at Mining Level 7[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]Radioactive Ore[/b] – Unlocks at Mining Level 10[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial]You’ll receive a mail notification when each new resource becomes available in the shops (Requires MFM).

In addition, this mod adds configuration options for building and crafting materials, including [b]Wood[/b], [b]Stone[/b], [b]Coal[/b], [b]Copper Ore[/b], [b]Iron Ore [/b]and [b]Gold Ore, [/b]allowing you to set individual prices for Year 1 and Year 2+.

By default, these use the vanilla shop prices, but you can adjust them freely. 

I also included a config option for the price of [b]Hay﻿[/b] from Marnie's for completeness sake, but like the base game this only has a Year 1 price, there is no price increase. 

[/font][font=Arial]To install just extract the zip and put it into your [b]Mods[/b] folder.

Requires:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url] (Optional: ﻿Delete the [MFM] folder if you'd rather not install Mail Framework Mod or just don't want the extra mails)
[/list][/font][/size]
